import java.util.*;
public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static final int maxm = 2000015;
    static final int maxn = 105 * 55;
    static int n, m, c, d, k;
    static class Edge {
        int to, next, cap, flow, cost;
        Edge(int to, int next, int cap, int flow, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }
    static Edge[] edge = new Edge[maxm];
    static int[] head = new int[maxn];
    static int tol;
    static int[] pre = new int[maxn];
    static int[] dis = new int[maxn];
    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[maxn];
    static int N;
    static int readInt(Scanner sc) {
        return sc.nextInt();
    }
    static void init(int n) {
        N = n;
        tol = 0;
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
    }
    static void addedge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
        edge[tol] = new Edge(v, head[u], cap, 0, cost);
        head[u] = tol++;
        edge[tol] = new Edge(u, head[v], 0, 0, -cost);
        head[v] = tol++;
    }
    static boolean spfa(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
        dis[s] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        vis[s] = true;
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            vis[u] = false;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = edge[i].next) {
                int v = edge[i].to;
                if (edge[i].cap > edge[i].flow && dis[v] > dis[u] + edge[i].cost) {
                    dis[v] = dis[u] + edge[i].cost;
                    pre[v] = i;
                    if (!vis[v]) {
                        vis[v] = true;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pre[t] != -1;
    }
    static int minCostMaxflow(int s, int t, int[] cost) {
        int flow = 0;
        cost[0] = 0;
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            int Min = INF;
            for (int i = pre[t]; i != -1; i = pre[edge[i ^ 1].to]) {
                if (Min > edge[i].cap - edge[i].flow)
                    Min = edge[i].cap - edge[i].flow;
            }
            for (int i = pre[t]; i != -1; i = pre[edge[i ^ 1].to]) {
                edge[i].flow += Min;
                edge[i ^ 1].flow -= Min;
                cost[0] += edge[i].cost * Min;
            }
            flow += Min;
        }
        return flow;
    }
    static int point(int x, int y) {
        return (x - 1) * 50 + y;
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int S = 101 * 55, T = S + 1;
        n = readInt(sc);
        m = readInt(sc);
        k = readInt(sc);
        c = readInt(sc);
        d = readInt(sc);
        int tmp;
        init(T + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            tmp = readInt(sc);
            addedge(S, tmp, 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 50; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 103; j++) {
                int x = point(j, i);
                int y = point(j + 1, i);
                addedge(x, y, INF, c);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 102; i++) {
            int tmp2 = i * 50 + 1;
            addedge(tmp2, T, INF, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int u = readInt(sc);
            int v = readInt(sc);
            for (int j = 1; j <= 102; j++) {
                int x = point(j, u);
                int x1 = point(j + 1, u);
                int y1 = point(j + 1, v);
                int y = point(j, v);
                for (int k = 0; k < 50; k++) {
                    int val = d * (k * 2 + 1) + c;
                    addedge(x, y1, 1, val);
                    addedge(y, x1, 1, val);
                }
            }
        }
        int[] costArr = new int[1];
        minCostMaxflow(S, T, costArr);
        System.out.println(costArr[0]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
